name: hCG during cycle

card.summary: Using human chorionic gonadotropin alongside anabolic steroid cycles to help keep testicular size and natural testosterone output, so users can sustain training and look.
card.note: Prescription hormone used off-label; sports-banned; anabolic steroids carry serious health and legal risks.

quick.overview:
Anabolic steroid users often add hCG during a cycle. Exogenous androgens suppress the brain's signal to the testes, which can shrink them, and hCG mimics luteinizing hormone, the signal that keeps the testes active. Users say this helps them keep testicular size and a more normal hormonal state, which they link to easier recovery and sustained training.

In medicine, hCG treats some forms of male hypogonadism and is used to preserve fertility during testosterone therapy. Its use alongside non-prescribed steroid cycles is not an approved indication, and published evidence is mostly expert reviews, with forum discussion forming most of the community record.
quick.how: Forum discussions describe hCG as one of several add-on drugs, along with aromatase inhibitors and SERMs, that users combine with their cycle and continue into or after it. Dosing varies widely between posters, and this wiki does not give instructions.
quick.risks: hCG is a prescription drug in the US and appears on some sports banned lists. Prolonged treatment in men can raise androgen production, and caution is advised with heart, kidney or seizure conditions. Forum users discuss estrogen-related side effects and often add aromatase inhibitors. The anabolic steroids it accompanies carry their own serious risks.

lead: hCG during cycle is a practice in anabolic steroid communities of taking human chorionic gonadotropin, a placental hormone, alongside a steroid cycle. Users do this chiefly to maintain testicular size and keep natural testosterone production active, aims they connect to recovery and a more stable physique-building process. [1][2]

hCG acts like luteinizing hormone, stimulating Leydig cells to produce testosterone. Medically it treats some forms of male hypogonadism, alone or with testosterone, and helps preserve fertility on testosterone therapy. [1] In steroid users, its role is to offset the testicular shrinkage that suppression causes. [1]
T Nation threads ask whether hCG is essential on a test-only cycle and how it affects recovery and estrogen. [2][3][5]

chain: hCG mimics LH and keeps testes active
Testicular size and some natural testosterone retained
angle.text: Users take hCG so that a cycle does not leave them with shrunken testes and a crashed natural system, which they associate with easier recovery and keeping gains.

paras: Posters on T Nation ask what benefits hCG offers on a test cycle and whether SERMs alone restore testicular size, with some saying it is not strictly necessary and others treating it as standard. [2][3][4][8] Threads describe it alongside aromatase inhibitors and PCT drugs; one poster notes concern that hCG can raise estrogen. [7] Another thread frames hCG on TRT mainly as a way to keep sperm production and prevent shrinkage. [5]

Anabolic steroids suppress natural testosterone production and can shrink the testes; hCG is used during and after cycles by users to maintain testicular size and restore output. [1] Clinically, prolonged treatment in men can increase androgen production, and caution is advised in people with heart, kidney or seizure conditions. [1] hCG is prescription-only in the US, and has been used in doping cases, with athletes such as Manny Ramirez and Brian Cushing suspended. [1]
No studies found on hCG co-administered with anabolic steroid cycles specifically. Fertility research on hCG in women, listed in medical databases, concerns a different use.

lore.intro: On T Nation, hCG on cycle is a recurring topic in cycle-planning threads. [3][4][6]

claims.claim: hCG keeps testicles from shrinking on cycle
claims.believers: Posters say it is what keeps size while on steroids. [5]
claims.experts: Wikipedia describes users taking hCG for this purpose via LH-mimicking action. [1]

claims.believers: Posters ask whether it helped recovery on cycle. [2]
claims.experts: No published studies were identified testing hCG on recovery in steroid users.
